company.name: Trelium
company.shortDescription: Trelium provides AI agents that automate recurring business workflows across SaaS and back-office systems.
company.description: Trelium develops artificial intelligence software that lets organizations build and deploy AI co-workers to handle repetitive digital work. Its platform allows users to describe workflows in plain English, then automatically generates agents that run those processes across Gmail, Printavo, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Qualia, Shopworks, Salesforce, Slack, and other tools. The agents monitor for triggers such as incoming purchase orders or status changes, extract structured data, update downstream systems, and send notifications or confirmations. Trelium supports different autonomy modes so teams can choose between supervised approvals, guided exception handling, or fully automated runs. Typical use cases include order entry from email, matching purchase orders to invoices, responding to order status queries, and moving files between systems. The software targets B2B operations, finance, and back-office teams seeking to remove manual copy-paste tasks and standardize workflows across their SaaS stack.
